about_the_game:
The Cult of the Night Goddess is on the move, and only you have a chance to stop them. Embark on a thrilling journey through lethal caverns and cannibal-infested lands to uncover their dark secret – and bring the truth to light!

Two new locations, Port Tarenis and Tiberius Vineyards will appear on your world map after you visit Freynagar in Chapter 4, letting you start the adventure that includes:

  • New Questline: Join forces with the Royal Court, venture deep under the earth, and make deals with cannibals to thwart the plans of Zoria's deadly cult. But perhaps all is not as it seems...

  • New Side Quests: Uncover the mystery lurking at the heart of Tiberius Vineyards. Help a noble dwarf fulfill the dreams of a lifetime. Resolve a scholarly feud in Wardenhaft Academy, and become an archaeologist to explore the lost Temple of Alvimelkedic.

  • New Areas: Explore the coast of Isilmerald and the fabled, deadly Gloomhalls. Visit new towns and settlements, not to mention the barbaric shores of the Savage Island.

  • New Riddles: Solve divine puzzles and encounter supernatural beings while exploring unplumbed depths.

  • New Spells and Items: Enhance your abilities with new magical items and incantations, empowering allies or smiting enemies. Become stronger than ever before.

Discover all this and more in Tales of the Moon Cult, an expansion pack DLC for Black Geyser: Couriers of Darkness.
